$comment: Engine/fuel indications and the sample loading example as cited facts; not a copy of any POH table or figure, not an instrument model and not a weighed aircraft. Field guide: README.md in this directory. Schema: data/schema/indication-loading-values.schema.json.
extraction: User decision GAPS Q23, 2026-11-02: (a) every engine and fuel indication of the classic-panel 172S joins the worker-computed ind state; (b) empty mass/CG come from the POH sample loading example, labelled as a sample. Each value was read on a rendered page image of S17 (SHA-256 prefix 420dbdaf5517a7a0); no Cessna text, table or figure is copied. Keys are proposed ind field names; the ind order is frozen in SCENARIO-CONTRACTS, not here. Estimated values (GAPS Q23 update 2026-11-02 08:01, input docs/input/2026-11-02-flightgear-gaps-codex-deferred.md) fill gaps S17 leaves open: dial ranges, the EGT scale, Hobbs counting and the low-fuel basis come from the FlightGear c172p model (S14, a 172P, another variant), as numbers and behaviour descriptions in our own words with file and commit; no FlightGear code, XML or asset is copied.

counting.value: One hour meter per engine option, accumulated in simulation time (FGData aircraft.timer on /sim/time/elapsed-sec, so pauses do not count and time acceleration does) from the moment the engine 'running' flag sets until it clears, updated every 60 s while running and on stop; the display shows the meter of the active engine option. Not rpm-weighted and not tied to oil pressure.

The estimate supplies only the time base (simulation seconds, no rpm weighting). The timer behaviour is in FGData Nasal/aircraft.nas (next bf48a45b, 2026-10-29), read for context and not a registered source.
